stem.text: A weight $W$ hangs from a trolley that runs along a rail. The trolley moves horizontally through a distance $p$ and simultaneously raises the weight through a height $q$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a trolley on a horizontal rail with a weight hanging below it. The weight is shown at two positions, labelled X and Y, with a dimension arrow r joining them and dimension arrows p (horizontal) and q (vertical). Printed labels: trolley, rail, weight W, X, Y, p, q, r.

stem.text: As a result, the weight moves through a distance $r$ from X to Y. It starts and finishes at rest.
How much work is done on the weight during this process?
